technical_specs.motion: Smooth orbit and seamless match cuts.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: 360-degree panoramic selfie-camera video. The camera rotates counter-clockwise through a bright pastel dessert shop, showing glass cases of colorful sweets and large windows. An adult woman with long wavy dark hair, a cream beret, and a layered pastel outfit poses at different points in the shop; at each completed camera turn, use a seamless match cut to change her outfit or a small fashion prop while maintaining face, hair, and position. Keep movement smooth, playful, and editorial, with clean bright lighting and no rendered text or logos.
